data.selection: All eligible native records, not selected using predictions

optimization.sampling: One shuffled visit per training record per epoch; no positive oversampling
optimization.pathology_loss: Masked stable BCEWithLogits, no positive class weights; Primary5 label weights 2 and other labels 1
optimization.rhythm_loss: Equal source/class mass, plus conditional agreement anchors; unknown rhythms masked
optimization.scheduler: Cosine from stated LR to 10% across original 20 epochs, identical in refit

selection.threshold_fit: All 2027 eligible fold-9 ECGs; per-label F1, fixed 19 thresholds 0.05..0.95; ties higher

control: Frozen starting model recalibrated on exactly the same expanded validation population, separating calibration from fitting effects
execution: CEDIA Slurm GPU only, strict deterministic algorithms, selected fits repeated before opening followup
